{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the number of patients after deduplication
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}')

# Check severity distribution on deduplicated data
severity_dist = data_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
severe_fraction = severity_dist.get('severe', 0)

print(f'\nSeverity distribution after deduplication:\n{severity_dist}')
print(f'\nFraction with severe baseline disease: {severe_fraction}')"}
